assay: C57BL/6 mice, 20 mg/kg IV, AST/ALT at 96 h
label: hepatotoxic if ALT > 100.0 U/L
caveat: 5 positive sequences. Too few to validate the endpoint; the confidence interval spans most of the range. Reported so the endpoint has some external signal, not as evidence of performance. These are 14-mer LNA gapmers, a chemistry and length the model was not trained on.
